detours.why: The Human Performance Center's mapped door is on its east side; from Pontchartrain North the walk crosses the service drive at the parking lot and goes round the building, with no mapped path through the trees between them.

notes.CSB: The Bulletin's Chemical Sciences Building (CSB) is the building OSM names 'Chemistry-Sciences Annex', the only chemistry building on Science Row beside the Science Building (lsuneworleans.edu/virtual-tour/chemistry).
notes.pontchartrain-halls: Pontchartrain Halls are two OSM buildings (Pontchartrain Hall North and South); pinned on North, which holds the Office of Residential Life (uno.edu/housing/contact), at its south end facing the walk between the two.
notes.privateer-place: Privateer Place apartments have no OSM building footprints (only the landuse area way/29014202); pinned on the clubhouse by the pool, just north of the complex entrance the operator's Google Maps link points to (campuslivingvillages.com Privateer Place page, goo.gl/maps/UJt7VHZzyHdkvKEk8 -> 30.029801, -90.071893), placed from Esri imagery.
notes.university-center: The University Center holds The Galley, UNO's cafeteria, plus Chick-fil-A and Subway (uno.edu/virtual-tour/uc); its name doesn't say dining.
